source.enumeration_basis: Every line of source/codigo-penal-1940.txt that opens an article ('Art. N', 'Art N', 'Art. N-X', 'Art. N-X-Y', revoked ones included), restricted to this part: Parte Especial Título XI Caps. II-B, III and IV, arts. 337-E–359-H (licitações, administração da justiça, finanças públicas). Generated mechanically by the conductor; units are articles.
source.enumeration_note: ONE PART (g6b) of twelve; registers/merge-parts.py merges them into registers/encoding-roadmap.json, whose enumeration is complete (434 units, every article number 1–361).

units.title: Contratação direta ilegal
units.note: Encoded whole: the crime, consummated or attempted (art. 14), from 1.4.2021 (Lei nº 14.133/2021, art. 194; an ordinary condition, the article did not exist before); 'fora das hipóteses previstas em lei' is the judge's finding on the procurement law (fork F-g6b-02); pena reclusão 4–8 e multa. Tests in cp-g6b-licitacoes-testes.l4.

units.title: Frustração do caráter competitivo de licitação
units.note: Encoded whole: a formal crime needing the intent and not a loss or an advantage obtained (fork F-sweep-c-13, Súmula 645 STJ, M-sweep-c-21); from 1.4.2021; pena reclusão 4–8 e multa.

units.title: Patrocínio de contratação indevida
units.note: Encoded whole: patronage, the tender or contract it brought about, and the judicial decree of invalidity, all required; no attempt (fork F-g6b-06); from 1.4.2021; pena reclusão 6 meses–3 anos e multa.

units.title: Modificação ou pagamento irregular em contrato administrativo
units.note: Encoded whole: both figures (the unauthorised change or advantage; the payment out of chronological order), the attempt on the first; from 1.4.2021; pena reclusão 4–8 e multa.

units.title: Perturbação de processo licitatório
units.note: Encoded whole, consummated or attempted; from 1.4.2021; pena detenção 6 meses–3 anos e multa.

units.title: Violação de sigilo em licitação
units.note: Encoded whole: both figures, consummated or attempted; from 1.4.2021; pena detenção 2–3 anos e multa.

units.title: Afastamento de licitante
units.note: Encoded whole: caput ('afastar ou tentar afastar', the attempt punished as the crime, so no art. 14 reduction) by violence against a person, serious threat, fraud or an offer of advantage (fork F-g6b-05 on 'violência'); parágrafo único (abstaining for an advantage), same pena; from 1.4.2021; pena reclusão 3–5 e multa, além da pena correspondente à violência.

units.title: Fraude em licitação ou contrato
units.note: Encoded whole: the fraud by one of the means of incisos I–V (an enum), 'em prejuízo da Administração Pública' read as a result (fork F-g6b-03), consummated or attempted; from 1.4.2021; pena reclusão 4–8 e multa.

units.title: Contratação inidônea
units.note: Encoded whole: caput (admission, 1–3), § 1º (contract, 3–6), § 2º (the unfit participant takes the caput's pena, the unfit contractor § 1º's); several forms at once take the heavier (as F-g0-18 reads it); from 1.4.2021.

units.title: Impedimento indevido
units.note: Encoded whole: both conducts, with 'injustamente'/'indevidamente' as the judge's finding; from 1.4.2021; pena reclusão 6 meses–2 anos e multa.

units.title: Omissão grave de dado ou de informação por projetista
units.note: Encoded whole: caput (with the three kinds of contracting as an enum); § 1º's definition of 'condição de contorno' folded into the conduct field's herald (the definition is read, not computed); § 2º as a cause of increase (fixa o dobro), listed and applied with the attempt's reduction; from 1.4.2021.

units.title: (sem rubrica no texto: a pena de multa dos crimes deste Capítulo)
units.note: Encoded whole: the floor (2% of the contract's value) on the fine's amount, checked with art. 58/49's limits (cp-pena); where the floor exceeds art. 49's largest fine the Code does not say which gives way, and the combined check refuses (fork F-g6b-04, a double bind in the text). The check reads the crime the fine is imposed for (`Crime cuja multa se fixa`: arts. 337-E–337-O, art. 337-M's two penas as two entries) and takes the pena from it; a crime outside the chapter is refused, art. 337-P reaching only 'os crimes previstos neste Capítulo' (2026-10-08, ta-g6's IT-g6-247: it had accepted any `Pena cominada`).

units.title: Reingresso de estrangeiro expulso
units.note: Encoded whole: the crime, consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–4 (no fine); 'sem prejuízo de nova expulsão após o cumprimento da pena' carried as the Code's words (an administrative measure the penalty does not prevent). Tests in cp-g6b-justica-reingresso-a-coacao-testes.l4.

units.title: Descumprimento de medidas protetivas de urgência
units.note: Encoded whole, from 8.12.2025 (Lei nº 15.280/2025, art. 7º; an ordinary condition, the article did not exist before): caput, consummated or attempted; § 1º as an invariance (the judge's civil or criminal competence is a field the rule deliberately does not read, asserted both ways); § 2º (bail only by the judge after an arrest in the act) as a predicate; § 3º carried as the Code's words. Pena reclusão 2–5 e multa.

units.title: Denunciação caluniosa
units.note: Encoded whole. Caput in the wording of Lei nº 14.110/2020 (in force 21.12.2020): the crime refuses for an earlier fact, whose wording is not in the source. The six proceedings the caput names; the imputation of a crime, an ético-disciplinar infraction, an ato ímprobo, or (by § 2º, fork F-g6b-07) a contravenção. Pena (1940) reclusão 2–8 e multa; § 1º (+1/6, anonymity) and § 2º (−1/2, contravenção only) as causes, listed and applied with the attempt's reduction.

units.title: Comunicação falsa de crime ou de contravenção
units.note: Encoded whole, consummated or attempted; pena detenção 1–6 meses, ou multa.

units.title: Auto-acusação falsa
units.note: Encoded whole: 'de crime' only (a self-accusation of a contravenção is not this crime, unlike art. 340's wording), consummated or attempted; pena detenção 3 meses–2 anos, ou multa.

units.title: Falso testemunho ou falsa perícia
units.note: Encoded whole. Caput and §§ 1º–2º in the wording of Lei nº 10.268/2001 (in force 29.8.2001) and the pena of Lei nº 12.850/2013 (in force 19.9.2013, 45 days counted by LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º): the crime refuses before 29.8.2001, the pena before 19.9.2013. The five capacities and the four kinds of proceeding (the prosecution's investigations are not 'processo administrativo', fork F-g6b-09). § 1º (+1/6 to 1/3) as a cause; § 2º's retraction makes the fact unpunishable, not the crime absent, and does not reach art. 343 (fork F-g6b-08). Pena reclusão 2–4 e multa. A party (`parte no processo`) or anyone else (`pessoa sem função no processo`) is not one of the five, and a statement in no proceeding (`nenhum processo ou procedimento`) is no crime (record members added 2026-10-08, ta-g6's IT-g6-272).

units.title: (sem rubrica no texto: dar, oferecer ou prometer vantagem a testemunha, perito, contador, tradutor ou intérprete)
units.note: Encoded whole, in the wording of Lei nº 10.268/2001 (in force 29.8.2001; every rule refuses for an earlier fact): the crime, consummated or attempted, over the same five persons as art. 342; pena reclusão 3–4 e multa; parágrafo único (+1/6 to 1/3, no 'suborno' limb) as a cause. The source prints no heading for art. 343; the mechanical title was art. 342's. A party, or anyone with none of the five roles, is not its object (2026-10-08, ta-g6's IT-g6-284).

units.title: Coação no curso do processo
units.note: Encoded whole: violence or serious threat (a plain threat is not enough), against anyone acting in a judicial, police or administrative proceeding or an arbitration, to favour an interest; consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–4 e multa, além da pena correspondente à violência. Parágrafo único (+1/3 to 1/2, crimes against sexual dignity) from 23.11.2021 (Lei nº 14.245/2021), an ordinary condition before. With no proceeding (`nenhum processo ou procedimento`) it is no crime, consummated or attempted (2026-10-08, ta-g6's IT-g6-289).

units.title: Exercício arbitrário das próprias razões
units.note: Encoded whole: the crime, consummated or attempted, with 'salvo quando a lei o permite' as the judge's finding; pena detenção 15 dias–1 mês, ou multa, além da pena correspondente à violência; the parágrafo único as the ação penal the article states (privada without violence against the person, fork F-g6b-05; NOTHING with it, art. 100 governing). Tests in cp-g6b-justica-exercicio-arbitrario-a-desobediencia-testes.l4.

units.title: (sem rubrica no texto: tirar, suprimir, destruir ou danificar coisa própria em poder de terceiro)
units.note: Encoded whole: 'coisa própria' is a cp-dominio Coisa that is not alheia; in a third party's hands by court order or agreement; consummated or attempted; pena detenção 6 meses–2 anos e multa. States no ação penal (art. 345's parágrafo único does not reach it). The source prints no heading for art. 346; the mechanical title was art. 345's parágrafo único.

units.title: Fraude processual
units.note: Encoded whole: caput (a civil or administrative proceeding pending) and parágrafo único (a penal one, even not begun), which both extends the crime and doubles the penalty (a cause, fixa o dobro; fork F-g6b-10 on the plural 'as penas'); consummated or attempted; pena detenção 3 meses–2 anos e multa.

units.title: Favorecimento pessoal
units.note: Encoded whole: caput and § 1º chosen by the favoured person's crime's own preceito (a Preceito secundário input; 'reclusão ou detenção' counts as reclusão cominada, fork F-g6b-12); § 2º's exemption for ascendente, descendente, cônjuge or irmão, as written (the companheiro not named, fork F-g6b-11); consummated or attempted. Penas: caput detenção 1–6 meses e multa, § 1º detenção 15 dias–3 meses e multa.

units.title: Favorecimento real
units.note: Encoded whole: 'fora dos casos de co-autoria ou de receptação' as facts and the judge's finding on receptação; no family exemption (art. 348, § 2º does not reach it); consummated or attempted; pena detenção 1–6 meses e multa.

units.title: (sem rubrica no texto: entrada de aparelho telefônico, de rádio ou similar em estabelecimento prisional)
units.note: Encoded whole, from 7.8.2009 (Lei nº 12.012/2009, art. 3º; an ordinary condition before): consummated or attempted; pena detenção 3 meses–1 ano (no fine). The source prints no heading; the mechanical title was art. 349's pena.

units.title: Exercício arbitrário ou abuso de poder (revogado pela Lei nº 13.869/2019)
units.note: Encoded as its revocation: the revoking law took effect 120 days after publication on 5.9.2019, i.e. on 3.1.2020 (LC nº 95/1998, art. 8º, § 1º); from then art. 350 is no crime, and a fact before it is refused by name because the article's text is not in the source.

units.title: Fuga de pessoa presa ou submetida a medida de segurança
units.note: Encoded whole: caput (detenção 6 meses–2 anos), § 1º (a mão armada — any weapon, fork F-g6b-13 —, two or more people, arrombamento: reclusão 2–6), § 2º (the violence's penalty as well), § 3º (the custodian: reclusão 1–4; with § 1º, the heavier), § 4º (the negligent funcionário custodian: detenção 3 meses–1 ano, ou multa; 'funcionário' by g6a's owner rule for art. 327, caput and § 1º, fork F-g6b-14 and integration ruling F-g6a-23). The intentional form consummated or attempted. The record says whose escape it is (`o fugitivo é o próprio agente`): the prisoner's own escape is not art. 351 in any form (fork F-g6b-23; 2026-10-08, ta-g6's IT-g6-321).

units.title: Evasão mediante violência contra a pessoa
units.note: Encoded whole: escaping or trying to (the attempt is the crime, no art. 14 reduction), with violence against a person; 'o preso' without art. 351's 'legalmente' (fork F-g6b-15); pena detenção 3 meses–1 ano, além da pena correspondente à violência.

units.title: Arrebatamento de preso
units.note: Encoded whole, with the aim to ill-treat; consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–4, além da pena correspondente à violência.

units.title: Motim de presos
units.note: Encoded whole: two or more prisoners (fork F-g6b-16) disturbing the prison's order or discipline; no attempt (fork F-g6b-06); pena detenção 6 meses–2 anos, além da pena correspondente à violência.

units.title: Patrocínio infiel; parágrafo único: Patrocínio simultâneo ou tergiversação
units.note: Encoded whole: caput (consummated or attempted) and parágrafo único, one pena, detenção 6 meses–3 anos e multa.

units.title: Sonegação de papel ou objeto de valor probatório
units.note: Encoded whole: destroying (with an attempt) or failing to return (an omission, no attempt, fork F-g6b-06) what the lawyer received; pena detenção 6 meses–3 anos e multa.

units.title: Exploração de prestígio
units.note: Encoded whole: the eight persons the article names (not the contador, which art. 342 names); consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–5 e multa; parágrafo único (+1/3) as a cause, listed and applied. The eight are a positive list; a party or anyone else is not one (2026-10-08, with the new members of `Pessoa que funciona no processo`).

units.title: Violência ou fraude em arrematação judicial
units.note: Encoded whole: two figures split at the semicolon, the means qualifying only the second (fork F-g6b-17), whose attempt is the crime; pena detenção 2 meses–1 ano, ou multa, além da pena correspondente à violência.

units.title: Desobediência a decisão judicial sobre perda ou suspensão de direito
units.note: Encoded whole, consummated or attempted; pena detenção 3 meses–2 anos, ou multa.

units.title: Contratação de operação de crédito
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000 (Lei nº 10.028/2000, art. 6º; an ordinary condition before): caput (no prior legislative authorisation) and parágrafo único I (a legal limit disregarded) and II (consolidated debt over its ceiling, 'ultrapassa', strict); consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–2 (no fine). Tests in cp-g6b-financas-publicas-testes.l4.

units.title: Inscrição de despesas não empenhadas em restos a pagar
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000: an expense not committed beforehand, or over its legal limit ('exceda', strict; the limit a MAYBE number); consummated or attempted; pena detenção 6 meses–2 anos.

units.title: Assunção de obrigação no último ano do mandato ou legislatura
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000. Two readings of 'os dois últimos quadrimestres do último ano do mandato ou legislatura' (fork F-g6b-18) and two of the contrapartida clause (fork F-g6b-19) are parameters of the rule, both executable, the taken ones TYPICALLY; they part when a term does not end on 31 December (witnesses in the tests). Whose term is the fact supplier's (F-g6b-21). Consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–4.

units.title: Ordenação de despesa não autorizada
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000, consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–4.

units.title: Prestação de garantia graciosa
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000: no counter-guarantee set up in the legal form, or one worth less than the guarantee ('igual ou superior' suffices, tested at equality); consummated or attempted; pena detenção 3 meses–1 ano.

units.title: Não cancelamento de restos a pagar
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000: the omission, where the amount entered is over what the law permits ('superior', strict); no attempt (an omission, fork F-g6b-06); pena detenção 6 meses–2 anos.

units.title: Aumento de despesa total com pessoal no último ano do mandato ou legislatura
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000. 'nos cento e oitenta dias anteriores ao final do mandato' in calendar days, two readings as a parameter (fork F-g6b-20: the 180 days ending on the last day, taken; or the 180 before it), with witnesses on 4 July and 31 December; counted by date arithmetic, not by cp-pena's Duração, which reads 180 days as six months. Consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–4.

units.title: Oferta pública ou colocação de títulos no mercado
units.note: Encoded whole, from 20.10.2000: securities not created by law, or not registered; consummated or attempted; pena reclusão 1–4.
